admission.countMeaning: Five bounded field families for each of three keys. Product qualification is descriptive source metadata only, not acceptance of original curated-row metadata.

fullWindowComparison.meaning: Current revised source versus unchanged curated inputs, not historical-vintage verification or a calibration exercise. Annual values compared at registered1decimal via Math.round(mean*10)/10; growth at registered2decimals via Math.round(growth*100)/100. Every retained2010–2025 row compared; no truncation. Not a fit/acceptance metric.
fullWindowComparison.decision: Do not replace curated series or attach source uncertainty to it. Mean-growth-definition mismatch/revisions remain explicit; matching rounded levels also do not establish original provenance.
